text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
To be the world's strongest... With that
goal in her heart, this
Umamusume is
taking on all challengers, right here in
France!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This international tour of hers is most
unprecedented, but the
unwavering
strength of her conviction is on full display
in this race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now, we've reached the fourth corner and
are heading into the
homestretch! After
waiting it out on the outside, El Condor
Pasa
makes her move!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Wow, oh, wow! She's left last year's Arc Umamusume and Europe's Umamusume of the Year in her dust!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's got this in the bag! Ahead by two,
now three lengths, she
crosses the finish
line!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Triumphing over the giants of the world
stage, the winner of the
French G1 Grand
Prix de Saint-Cloud is...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
EL CONDOR PASA! She's made another
dream come true for her fans
back in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bien! Even across the globe, El's the
greatest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And now... I'm one step closer to my goal.
The Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe is finally
within my grasp!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Until now just a mere fantasy, her dream of
conquering the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe
feels more and more real!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will El Condor Pasa achieve this
magnificent feat and make history?
Her
fans the world over are anxious to find out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, El, you're so cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Special Week toppled fearsome foes
Seiun Sky and Mejiro
Bright in the spring
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We gather as a team to celebrate her
victory.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Before we begin, let's hear a few
words from Special Week,
the star of
today's show!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You go, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Give us a good speech!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-ummm! These consecutive wins are
all thanks to my
teammates'—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Cheers to that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wha-huh?! Ch-cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, Spe's been in
the news a whole lot lately.
Everyone's
saying the Golden Generation's Derby
Umamusume is the
real deal!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and your showing at the spring
Tenno Sho really helped.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've always had talent, but now you're
able to put all that talent on
display when
you run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Do you mean that?! Thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To be perfectly honest, I feel like I've
changed a lot too! It's like... I
can run with
confidence or something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's senior year is off to a
spectacular start with a
three-race win
streak, including the G1 spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From her smile, it seems her superb
physical condition has spilled
over into her
emotional state as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We also have a present for our talented
Special Week... Well, rather
than a
"present," I should say we have some
wonderful news.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What kind of news?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
In the Takarazuka Kinen fan polls... you
ranked number one, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wha... what?! I-I'm number one?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That may sound a tad scary, but that
should tell you just how amazing
you've
been doing up until now.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've grown so much that fans want to
support you the most.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, compared to when you first transferred in, you're way more reliable now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Do you really think so?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But you've got lots and LOTS of races
ahead of you... so make sure
you stuff
yourself silly with this here banquet! Fine
food makes fine
racers!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A fine racer... I see what you mean! Then I
better not let any of this
fine food go to
waste!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Whether it be the Takarazuka
Kinen or this food, I'll show no
mercy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, thanks, everyone! Today was really
special!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maybe this goes without saying, but both my stomach and heart feel full after hearing you all say such nice things about me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So now I'm ready to give training even
more of my all and make my
dreams come
true!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How exactly I'll become the best in Japan
still isn't totally clear to
me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But even if it's just to pay you all back for
your love and support, I'll
make sure it
happens!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Awwww! That's so noble of you, Spe! We'll
be cheering you on the
whole waaay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we will do everything in our power
to help. Seeing you
become the best racer
in Japan will more than suffice as thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Continuing her stellar performance will be
no easy task, especially
considering
Special Week's generation has been called
the Golden
Generation for some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, she's already suffered a number of
bitter defeats at their
hands... but Special
Week has always bounced back.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So if I want to make my dream come
true—if I really want to be the
best—I
need to keep running like I did today!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, starting tomorrow, I'm putting
you through the ringer, got it?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, starting tomorrow, I'm putting
you through the ringer, got it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The best in Japan... a lofty ambition,
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But tonight has only served to renew my
resolve—I'll do whatever it
takes to see her
dream made reality.
